name: pds-project-ai-assets
description: Public agent assets for the PDS Project AI MCP server

scripts.package:agents: npm run compile && npm run compile:agents && node scripts/package-agents.mjs
scripts.site:dev: npm run package:agents && npm run site:data && npm --prefix site run dev
scripts.site:check: npm run package:agents && npm run site:data && npm --prefix site run check
scripts.site:build: npm run package:agents && npm run site:data && npm --prefix site run build
scripts.test: node scripts/validate-assets.mjs && npm run compile && npm run compile:agents && npm run generate:teams-packages && npm run check:generated && npm run check:agents && npm run check:teams-packages && npm run validate:teams-packages && npm run verify:agents
